notes: The first 4 records are NSW sources; the 7 records added on 4 November 2026 are the other jurisdictions' revenue office contractor guidance, discovery only. Their Acts are linked from the skill's jurisdiction table and not indexed: 6 of the 7 sit on legislation registers outside the reviewed fetch list. The skill requires a separate current-source test in every jurisdiction where work is performed. Human review pending: agency liability (Part 3 Division 8, ss 36A-42) and grouping (Part 5, ss 70-74A, 79 and 81) were read by an agent from the whole in-force Act on 23 September 2026 (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills/blob/f4acd41fae295695377d80564f27228eac8acdeb/docs/source-review-2026-09-23.md). The Act URL below returned 403 to the 16 September fetch. No new human review is asserted.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 2007 (NSW)
sources.fact: The relevant-contract and exemption tests must be read from the in-force Act for NSW and must not be projected into another jurisdiction.

sources.title: Revenue NSW contractors and payroll tax
sources.fact: Current operational guidance supports, but does not replace, the statutory contractor tests and exemptions.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 2007 (NSW), section 11
sources.fact: Wholly NSW services use subsection (1)(a); the conditional interstate hierarchy is subsection (1)(b). Wholly overseas services and months without services have separate rules.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 2007 (NSW), section 32
sources.fact: Subsection (2)(d) covers vehicle-supplied goods conveyance. It has no insurance-procurement or door-to-door-sales subparagraphs.
